Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's own statement of rights, quoted below, says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not say in which country the text was first published. The last person to die, C. E. Montague, died in 1928, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries on 1 January 1999.
